description: This file contains functions that set up mock server expectations using the mockserver-client library, specifically for testing OpenAPI specifications loaded from various sources (URL, file, classpath, JSON/YAML literals).

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByHttpUrl
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation by loading an OpenAPI spec from a URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperation
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with specific operations and responses, loading spec from URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByFileUrl
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation by loading an OpenAPI spec from a file URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByClasspathLocation
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation by loading an OpenAPI spec from a classpath location.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByJsonLiteral
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with an OpenAPI spec loaded from a JSON literal file content.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByYamlLiteral
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with an OpenAPI spec loaded from a YAML literal string.
